goal: Add a shouting variant to the alpha module and create a beta module with its own test file

nodes.instruction: Modify src/alpha.js to add a shouting variant of the alpha function that returns 'ALPHA!' (in uppercase with exclamation mark), while keeping the original alpha function unchanged.
nodes.title: Add shouting variant to alpha

nodes.instruction: Create src/beta.js with a simple function that returns 'beta'.
nodes.title: Create beta module

nodes.instruction: Create src/beta.test.js with a test for the beta function asserting it returns 'beta'.
nodes.title: Add test for beta
